name: Matt Pocock Skills
summary: 被 Super Brain 吸收的工程、产品、连续性与学习冷能力源。它们不作为独立 Codex 技能安装。

verification: route receipt names evidence and verification requirements
the native loop preserves authorization and H7 boundaries
proposal names scope, non-goals, and acceptance criteria
no tracker or external mutation is authorized by the capability
assistance remains scoped to the active task
the capability never replaces H7 continuity or authorization
lesson outcome is distinguishable from project evidence
no learning record is stored without authorization
handoff binds the H7 phase, evidence, next action, and return point
handoff artifact creation remains authorization-gated
challenge receipt records assumptions and resolution
one bounded question or review step never authorizes a change

nativeOutcomes: Super Brain selects a verified native capability without exposing a host-skill menu
enhancements: H7 scope and authorization remain authoritative
acceptance: reference-only source is never emitted as an automatic executable card

sourceOutcomes: diagnose failures, regressions, and performance problems
nativeOutcomes: current evidence, FACT/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN, discriminating check, and focused regression
enhancements: project evidence and authorization gates precede repair
acceptance: root-cause status and focused verification are explicit

sourceOutcomes: stress-test a design and identify decision documentation needs
nativeOutcomes: challenge design assumptions with current evidence and bounded ADR/glossary proposals
enhancements: document writes stay proposal-only until approved
acceptance: each accepted decision has evidence, tradeoff, and authorized artifact target

sourceOutcomes: triage issues and create agent-ready briefs
nativeOutcomes: prepare evidence-backed priority and state-transition proposals
acceptance: proposed priority and transition are visible before any external action

nativeOutcomes: compare module and boundary options against live project evidence
enhancements: generic patterns cannot substitute for current call-site and test evidence
acceptance: recommendation names source evidence, constraints, and focused acceptance

nativeOutcomes: produce a bounded setup proposal with every project and external change listed
enhancements: setup cannot perform tracker or document mutation without approval
acceptance: scope and mutation targets are explicitly approved before execution

nativeOutcomes: define observable acceptance, focused failing case, smallest repair, and targeted regression
enhancements: tests remain tied to current project behavior and authorized change scope
acceptance: failing case, passing case, and focused regression are demonstrated

sourceOutcomes: decompose an approved plan into deliverable issues
nativeOutcomes: propose independently verifiable work items with scope and acceptance
enhancements: issue publication is never implied by decomposition
acceptance: each proposed item is checked against approved scope and criteria

sourceOutcomes: turn discussion into a PRD or requirements specification
nativeOutcomes: produce a proposed PRD with scope, non-goals, and acceptance criteria
enhancements: publication and external records stay separate from synthesis
acceptance: publication target and authorization are explicit before external action

nativeOutcomes: define question, disposal boundary, and observation before an authorized experiment
enhancements: prototype cannot silently become a production change
acceptance: the observation resolves the stated question or stops the experiment

nativeOutcomes: validate terms and boundaries against current code, documents, and accepted domain meaning
enhancements: business terminology is not invented or stored without evidence
acceptance: terms and boundary decisions identify current evidence

sourceOutcomes: design module boundaries, interfaces, seams, and testability
nativeOutcomes: compare boundary options against call sites, tests, and explicit tradeoffs
enhancements: generic designs cannot override current source evidence
acceptance: proposed boundary names evidence, test strategy, and tradeoff

sourceOutcomes: challenge an important plan or design
nativeOutcomes: run a bounded challenge gate for assumptions and counterexamples
enhancements: challenge intent wins over generic test wording and cannot authorize mutation
acceptance: receipt records challenged assumption and resolved, deferred, or unknown decision

sourceOutcomes: ask one question at a time to challenge a plan
nativeOutcomes: serve as the bounded internal adapter used by the native challenge gate
enhancements: adapter is never a standalone automatic or host route
acceptance: loop stops on answer, stop signal, or no material assumption

nativeOutcomes: bind phase, evidence, next action, and return point through H7
enhancements: handoff never replaces H7 contracts or creates an artifact without authorization
acceptance: H7-bound handoff receipt verifies phase, evidence, next action, and return point

sourceOutcomes: teach a requested concept with examples
nativeOutcomes: provide workspace-relevant explanation, example, and check-back
enhancements: lesson output is not conflated with project evidence or durable memory
acceptance: user check-back or small example demonstrates learning outcome

nativeOutcomes: review a Super Brain capability trigger, boundary, provenance, and verification contract
enhancements: cannot install a standalone skill or write project capability files without approval
acceptance: review checks trigger, boundary, source provenance, verification, and non-authorizing behavior

skills.name: ask-matt
canDo: Explain which absorbed capability fits a verified task without exposing a host skill menu.
cannotDo: Replace Super Brain intent routing, H7 scope, or user authorization.
verification: Selected capability has explicit metadata and a verified cold source.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the task already has a high-confidence Super Brain capability card.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
canDo: Run an evidence-first diagnosis loop for failures, regressions, and slow behavior.
cannotDo: Claim a root cause without current project evidence and a discriminating verification.
verification: Record FACT/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN and run a focused regression after the repair.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the issue is not a defect, regression, or performance investigation.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
canDo: Stress-test a design and propose ADR or glossary artifacts when they are explicitly useful.
cannotDo: Write project documents or replace H7 approval merely because a challenge was requested.
verification: Each accepted design decision names evidence, tradeoffs, and an owner-approved artifact target.
skills.stopCondition: Skip for a simple implementation request without a design decision to challenge.

skills.name: triage
canDo: Prepare evidence-backed triage proposals and agent-ready briefs.
cannotDo: Change an issue tracker, labels, issue state, or external PR without exact action, target, and impact approval.
verification: Show the proposed state transition and verify the exact approved external target before action.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when no issue or pull-request workflow is in scope.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
canDo: Inspect current code for bounded architecture opportunities and compare them against project evidence.
cannotDo: Treat an HTML report, a cold source, or a generic pattern as proof that a refactor is authorized.
verification: Tie each recommendation to live source evidence, constraints, and a focused acceptance check.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the task is not an architecture or module-boundary decision.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
canDo: Propose a repository-specific issue, triage, and domain-document setup plan.
cannotDo: Configure trackers, labels, or documents without the current project's explicit mutation and external-action approvals.
verification: List every intended project and external change before implementation.
skills.stopCondition: Skip unless the user explicitly asks to establish this workflow.

skills.name: tdd
canDo: Shape a focused red-green-refactor loop for an authorized feature or repair.
cannotDo: Invent behavior without an observable acceptance target.
verification: Demonstrate the intended failing case, the passing case, and the targeted regression.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when testing does not clarify the change or is outside task constraints.

skills.name: to-issues
canDo: Turn an approved plan or PRD into proposed independently deliverable work items.
cannotDo: Create or edit tracker issues without exact external action, target, and impact approval.
verification: Validate each proposed issue against the approved scope and acceptance criteria before external publication.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when no plan, spec, or issue breakdown is requested.

skills.name: to-prd
canDo: Synthesize current approved discussion into a proposed PRD or requirements specification.
cannotDo: Publish to an issue tracker or alter external project records without exact approval.
verification: Show scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and intended publication target before any external action.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the user did not request a product requirement or specification artifact.

skills.name: prototype
canDo: Propose a bounded throwaway experiment to answer a design or behavior question.
cannotDo: Turn an experiment into a production change or create files without project authorization.
verification: State the question, disposal boundary, and observation that ends the experiment.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when a focused test or existing evidence can answer the question more cheaply.

skills.name: domain-modeling
canDo: Clarify domain language, boundaries, and architecture decisions from current project evidence.
cannotDo: Invent business terminology or store a decision without evidence and approval.
verification: Confirm terms against current code, documents, and the user's accepted domain meaning.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the task does not need a domain boundary or terminology decision.

skills.name: codebase-design
canDo: Design or improve a module boundary, interface, seam, and testability strategy.
cannotDo: Replace current code evidence with a generic design pattern.
verification: Validate the proposed boundary against call sites, tests, and an explicit tradeoff.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when no module or interface decision is present.

skills.name: grill-me
canDo: Open a Super Brain internal challenge gate before an important plan or design is accepted.
cannotDo: Become a standalone host skill, authorize changes, or replace the H7 lifecycle.
verification: Capture challenged assumptions, counterexamples, and the user's resolved decision.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the user is not asking to challenge a plan or design.

skills.name: grilling
canDo: Run one bounded question at a time to test a plan or design.
cannotDo: Loop indefinitely, bypass the user's stop signal, or create a standalone host entry.
verification: End with an explicit resolved, deferred, or unknown decision.
skills.stopCondition: Stop on the user's answer, stop signal, or when no material assumption remains.

skills.name: handoff
canDo: Turn current verified state into a bounded handoff artifact only when an artifact is useful and authorized.
cannotDo: Replace H7 contracts, checkpoints, latest user instruction, or create a handoff document without project authorization.
verification: Handoff must bind current phase, evidence, next action, and return point through H7.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when H7 continuity already supplies the required state and no artifact is requested.

skills.name: teach
canDo: Teach a requested concept or workflow with workspace-relevant examples.
cannotDo: Pretend a lesson is project evidence or store learning records without authorization.
verification: Use a small check-back, example, or user-confirmed outcome appropriate to the lesson.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the user wants execution rather than explanation or learning support.

skills.name: writing-great-skills
canDo: Provide predictable skill-authoring principles and review a proposed Super Brain capability boundary.
cannotDo: Install a standalone host skill or write project skill files without current project authorization.
verification: Check trigger, boundary, source provenance, verification, and non-authorizing behavior.
skills.stopCondition: Skip when the task is not about authoring or improving a reusable capability.
